nodes.label: W-253 — thirty goldens re-banked, and a finding that proved itself by leaving
nodes.rationale: The census first, the re-bank second — W-200's rule.

nodes.label: The main volume's md5 moved and its byte count did not
nodes.rationale: The main volume carries the Register's own counts at §28 and those are re-taken in the same build: same length, different bytes. A build that seated entries and left the main md5 alone would be the thing to worry about.

nodes.label: 196 left the withdrawn-set list when an unrelated tally changed
nodes.rationale: A reading can be wrong, so the instrument's own behaviour becomes the evidence: a number that departs when an unrelated tally moves was never a citation. Recorded as corroboration, not as a new finding.
